attchmntText: Omkar Speciality Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Omkar Speciality Chemicals Limited published newspaper advertisements for its Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and taken on record by the Board of Directors on November 14, 2026. Sparc Electrex Limited reported a net loss of 2.91 Lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Its bank accounts were frozen on November 24, 2025, due to non-payment of outstanding income tax demands. Essel Lucknow Raebareli Toll Roads Limited reported a net loss of 105.78 Lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Multiplus Holdings Limited reported a net profit of 37.74 Lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Omkar Speciality Chemicals Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Omkar Speciality Chemicals Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a loss of 96.64 Lakhs for the quarter and 132.71 Lakhs for the half year. Revenue from operations was nil. Finance costs amounted to 50.72 Lakhs. The financial statements are prepared on a going concern basis following the implementation of a Resolution Plan approved by the NCLT on July 31, 2025. The company expects to commence regular commercial operations. Paid-up equity share capital remains at 2,057.80 Lakhs. Earnings per share were negative 0.47 for the quarter and negative 0.64 for the half year. Statutory auditors R R Tibrewala & Co. issued a limited review report with no modifications.
